title: Lazy Sunday Thai Chicken Curry
description: A nutty and fluffy Thai dish featuring mature cheddar and Mediterranean-friendly flavors, perfect for a lazy Sunday
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together fish sauce, brown sugar, and curry paste to create a marinade.
Add the chicken to the marinade and mix well to coat, then cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook the marinated chicken until browned, about 5-7 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside, then reduce heat to medium and add more oil if necessary.
Add the shredded cheese to the skillet and stir until melted and smooth.
Pour in the coconut milk and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Return the chicken to the skillet and stir to coat with the curry sauce.
Reduce heat to low and let cook, covered, for 10-15 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, then garnish with chopped basil leaves.
Serve hot over rice or noodles.
